name: Agile / User Story
description: Lightweight agile PRD with epics, user stories and acceptance criteria

sections.title: Product Overview
sections.prompt_hint: Summarize the product vision, goals and target users in 2-3 paragraphs.

sections.title: Epics
sections.prompt_hint: List the major epics (high-level features). For each epic provide: title, description, business value.

sections.title: User Stories
sections.prompt_hint: Break each epic into user stories using the format: 'As a [role], I want [feature] so that [benefit]'. Group by epic.

sections.title: Acceptance Criteria
sections.prompt_hint: For each user story provide 3-5 Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

sections.title: Non-Functional Requirements
sections.prompt_hint: List performance, security, scalability and usability requirements.

sections.title: Constraints & Assumptions
sections.prompt_hint: List technical constraints, business constraints and key assumptions.

sections.title: Suggested Sprint Plan
sections.prompt_hint: Suggest a sprint breakdown (Sprint 1-N) with user stories per sprint and estimated effort.
